title: Duality bound for ∇h from L^2 convergence of Lipschitz functions with bounded energy
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (R E : ℝ) (u : ℕ → Euclid n → ℝ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) (W h : Euclid n → ℝ) (Φ : Fin n → Euclid n → ℝ), (∀ j, ∃ L : NNReal, LipschitzWith L (u j)) → (∀ j, ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) R, ‖fderiv ℝ (u j) x‖ ^ 2 ≤ E) → MemLp W 2 (volume.restrict (ball (0 : Euclid n) R)) → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) R, (u j x - c j - W x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 h (ball (0 : Euclid n) R) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (ball (0 : Euclid n) R)), h x = W x) → (∀ i, ContDiff ℝ 1 (Φ i)) → (∀ i, HasCompactSupport (Φ i)) → (∀ i, tsupport (Φ i) ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid n) R) → ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) R, ∑ i : Fin n, fderiv ℝ h x (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) * Φ i x ≤ Real.sqrt E * Real.sqrt (∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) R, ∑ i : Fin n, Φ i x ^ 2)
